basic_info.description: Discover the pinnacle of urban living with this rarely available penthouse-level condo in the prestigious Parc Telegraph building. With breathtaking, unobstructed views of Alcatraz, Treasure Ild, and the shimmering Bay, this one-bedroom sanctuary is perfect for first-time homebuyers or those seeking a second home in the heart of San Francisco.    Picture yourself in your serene bedroom, a private retreat designed for peaceful nights and restful mornings. Beyond your sanctuary, the open floor plan creates an effortless flow between your fully equipped kitchen, living spaces, and dining area. The thoughtful layout, modern design, and convenience of in-unit laundry make daily life a breeze - whether you're hosting friends for dinner or simply relaxing after work, every space feels both welcoming and refined. Living at Parc Telegraph means you're just a block away from the iconic Embarcadero, with easy access to the Financial District, North Beach, and the bustling activity of Pier 39. Want a night in? Take advantage of the beautifully designed common areas, or head to the fitness center for a workout before winding down with the romantic night views of the Bay. Secure garage parking, assigned space, and round-the-clock security add peace of mind to this North Waterfront gem.
